name: Investment Fund Transaction
definition: Process of buying, selling, switching or transferring fund units.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of an order assigned by a client.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Direction of the transaction, ie, securities are received (credited) or delivered (debited).

InvestmentFundOrder.name: Investment Fund Order
InvestmentFundOrder.definition: An investor's instruction to either subscribe or redeem an amount of money or its equivalent, eg, other assets, into or out of an investment fund.

TransactionCharge.name: Transaction Charge
TransactionCharge.definition: Charge for the placement of an order and/or for its execution.

InvestmentAccount.name: Investment Account
InvestmentAccount.definition: Account related to an investment fund transaction.

InvestmentFundClass.name: Investment Fund Class
InvestmentFundClass.definition: Investment fund class to which an investment fund order and its execution are related.

TransactionTax.name: Transaction Tax
TransactionTax.definition: Tax applicable to an investment fund order and/or to its execution.

InvestmentFundOrderExecution.name: Investment Fund Order Execution
InvestmentFundOrderExecution.definition: Creation/cancellation of investment units on the books of the fund or its designated agent, as a result of executing an investment fund order.
